name: Document-VLM inference provider
one_line: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving an open VLM (Qwen2.5-VL-7B measured; Qwen3-VL-8B vendor-reported) at a measured document accuracy/cost operating point, billed per page and sold on a same-pages rerunnable benchmark; the 0.925-vs-0.880 DocVQA seed is real but relaxed-match on 200 pages, the "~40x cheaper" is a list-price model whose Qwen token count contradicts the repo's own measurement (corrected modeled ratio ~9-10x), and the in-model pruning moat sprint has no result.

numeric_claims.source: /home/user/dexa/evals/RESULTS.md section 'Multimodal execution thesis' table; context/01-evidence-ledger-dexa.md entry doc-vlm-frontier

GPT-4o scored 0.880 on the same 200 DocVQA pages (detail high, images capped at 2048 long side, temperature 0, max_tokens 32); GPT-4o-mini accuracy and measured $/1k pages not recorded; commit c729976 2026-08-04

OpenAI patch-based models count 32x32 patches x multiplier (1.2 for gpt-5.2-5.6); 1024x1024 = 1,229 tokens on gpt-5.4 (~$0.0031 at $2.50/M; ~$0.00025 on gpt-5.6-luna at $0.20/M, i.e. ~$0.25/1K pages derived); gpt-4o tiles 85 base + 170 per 512px tile
OpenAI and Anthropic Batch pricing is 50% of standard
Claude counts 28x28 patches; 1000x1000 = 1,296 tokens; at Haiku 4.5 $1/MTok ~ $1.30 per 1K images; PDFs add 1,500-3,000 text tokens per page plus image tokens

Gemini: 258 tokens per 768px tile (2.5-era rule); Gemini 3 media_resolution 280/560/1120/2240 per image and 280/560/1120 per PDF page with native PDF text uncharged; Gemini 3.8 Flash $0.75/M input -> a 560-token page ~ $0.00042, ~ $0.42 per 1K pages input-only (derived)

Secondary aggregators list Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct at $0.20 per 1M tokens on DeepInfra and Fireworks (medium confidence)

olmOCR-2-7B-1025 is fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-7B; olmOCR-Bench 82.4; synthetic training data cost ~$0.12 per page via Claude Sonnet 4
dots.mocr olmOCR-Bench 83.9 (3B, MIT, integrated in vLLM 0.11.0)
InternVL3.5 Visual Resolution Router reduces visual tokens ~50% while retaining nearly 100% performance; 4.05x inference speedup over InternVL3
DeepSeek-OCR: 97% OCR precision at compression <10x, ~60% at 20x; surpasses GOT-OCR2.0 using 100 vision tokens
vLLM ships --video-pruning-rate (EVS default, VidCom2 for Qwen3-VL) with no image-pruning flag; RFC #45098 '--image-pruning-rate' opened 2026-06-10, open, no maintainer comments visible

DeepSeek off-peak rates are half of peak rates

unproven.claim: Content-aware in-model visual-token pruning beats naive resize at a matched token budget on documents (the execution-owned moat)
unproven.experiment: Reimplement Qwen2.5-VL get_rope_index position handling for a pruned token set in the HF path (recorded blocker: [3,1671] computed positions vs [3,881] masked), then run evals/modal_vlm_moat.py at FRACTIONS 0.5 and 0.25 on DocVQA; proceed if best prune-norm/prune-query accuracy minus resize accuracy >= +0.02 (the script's own verdict threshold); kill if <= 0.00

unproven.claim: Qwen3-VL-8B reproduces >= 93 DocVQA ANLS on this harness and shows the same resize frontier shape as Qwen2.5-VL-7B
unproven.experiment: Rerun evals/modal_vlm_frontier.py with Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, an ANLS scorer, N >= 1,000 pages, serving mode (CUDA graphs on); compare to the vendor-reported 96.1

unproven.cost_estimate: 2 A100-hours plus OpenAI API spend; 2 calendar days

founder_decisions.decision: Whether the per-page document-AI market is worth entering as a company versus treating document VLM serving as a feature of another direction
founder_decisions.options: Enter as a standalone provider; ship as one endpoint inside a broader VLM/agent provider; do not enter
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The research files give list prices and tier breakpoints (Azure $0.60/1K above 1M pages; Google above 5M) but no volumes or market sizes; the founder's rule forbids market-size judgments; design-partner conversions are the evidence that would inform it

founder_decisions.decision: Whether the adjacency of Reducto r-1 ($0.01/page), Mistral OCR 4 ($2-4/1K), cloud OCR tiers, and hosted Qwen3-VL on Together/DeepInfra/Fireworks matters
founder_decisions.options: Compete head-on on the same-pages benchmark; position as the open-weight/self-hostable alternative; partner or resell
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The founder's rule forbids 'already exists' judgments; the facts are stated neutrally in section 9 and none of those vendors publishes a same-pages result against open VLMs

founder_decisions.decision: Hosted endpoint vs BYOC vs harness-only open source
founder_decisions.options: Hosted per-page API (serve/modal_doc_vlm_serve.py); BYOC compose in the customer's cloud (dexa_platform/docker-compose.byoc.yml); release only the benchmark harness and operating-point config
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: All three artifacts exist in the repo; which one buyers want is unmeasured and depends on the founder's go-to-market preference

founder_decisions.decision: Model choice: Qwen2.5-VL-7B vs Qwen3-VL-8B vs a document fine-tune
founder_decisions.options: Qwen2.5-VL-7B (measured 0.925 vs 0.880 relaxed on 200 pages); Qwen3-VL-8B (vendor-reported 96.1 DocVQA, unreproduced, Apache-2.0); fine-tune on document data (olmOCR-2-7B precedent at ~$0.12/page synthetic data)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Week-1 ANLS reproduction is the evidence; the trade between measured-but-older and vendor-reported-but-newer, and whether to invest in training, is a founder risk call

founder_decisions.options: A100-80GB (all measurements); H100/H200; L40S; AMD MI355X ($2.29-2.95/GPU-hour rental per Wafer)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Only A100-80GB is measured for this workload; the cost floor on other parts is unmeasured and the choice depends on the founder's capacity strategy

founder_decisions.decision: Whether to fund the in-model pruning moat sprint before or after market validation
founder_decisions.options: Run the 6-15 GPU-hour spike first so the pitch is not 'a config flag'; validate demand first as the repo recorded ('gate the moat sprint on market validation'); skip the sprint and rely on benchmark plus per-page pricing
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The sprint has no result either way; sequencing is a capital-allocation judgment the repo explicitly deferred

founder_decisions.decision: Product shape: question-answering/extraction vs full-page transcription vs both
founder_decisions.options: QA/extraction only (measured); transcription/parse (unmeasured cost and quality on olmOCR-Bench); both with separate per-page tiers
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Only QA is measured; transcription economics are decode-heavy and unmeasured; the choice defines which incumbents are the comparison set

founder_decisions.decision: Per-page vs per-token pricing, and whether to publish the modeled compute floor ($0.017-0.023 per 1K pages at 100% utilization)
founder_decisions.options: Per-page tiers by output type with a batch/standby discount; per-token like hosted Qwen3-VL providers; hybrid
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Where list price sits between the modeled floor and the $0.20-$15 per 1K anchors is a margin and positioning judgment; the floor itself is a model with stated assumptions, not a measurement
